title: Staff Phone (composed, strict)
description: Generated by 08-tools/build-schemas.ts from the raw schema plus registered extensions. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: node 08-tools/build-schemas.ts
x-docId: the person's id. The driver code AB-1234 for a driver. The staff doc id for a staff member.
x-reads: adminpanel: district staff only, see x-read-rule
x-read-rule: Only the DDO and the TDO may read a raw phone. An inspector sees phoneMasked on the person they are looking at. ADR-0005 is the masked-phone decision, and this collection is the exception it names: the raw number exists for the district, not for the whole panel.
x-why-separate: A Firestore get returns the WHOLE document. Rules do not redact fields. So if the raw phone lived on the drivers doc, the driver's own read of that doc would return it, no matter how the rule is written. The only way to keep the raw phone out of the driver's read path is to put it in a different collection with a different rule.

phone.description: The RAW phone. Never sent to the driver app. Never sent to the user app.

updatedBy.description: The staff doc id who wrote it.
